name: Corporate Action SD 20
definition: Provides additional information regarding corporate action details.

PlaceAndName.name: Place And Name
PlaceAndName.definition: Xpath to the element that is being extended.

LotterySequenceNumber.name: Lottery Sequence Number
LotterySequenceNumber.definition: DTC generated number to distinguish between the series of lotteries run against a particular redemption.

LotteryDate.name: Lottery Date
LotteryDate.definition: Date/time on which the lottery is run and applied to the holder's positions. This is also applicable to partial calls.

ProcessToDate.name: Process To Date
ProcessToDate.definition: For Reorganization events, date at which instructions will be accepted by agent for payment.
